title: wg: content-09 §4.3 extension value size contradicts A.1 and C.10
description: Erratum. §4.3 (L536) value = any .size (0..4095); A.1 (L2848) value = any; C.10 (L3370) "removed the maximum length of MIMI content extensions". A.2 (L2888-2889) also redefines name/value with the limit, colliding with A.1's rule names. mimid follows A.1 (decision mimid-1wgh.2.15). Fix: remove the limit in §4.3 and rename A.2's rules.
